# Sri Kalabhairaveshwara Swamy Temple, Manakathuru

> Website of the Sri Kalabhairaveshwara Swamy Temple (ಶ್ರೀ ಕಾಲಭೈರವೇಶ್ವರ ಸ್ವಾಮಿ ದೇವಸ್ಥಾನ) in Manakathuru village (ಮನಕತ್ತೂರು; also written Manakathur, Manakatur, Manakattur), about 4 km north of Banavara, Arsikere Taluk, Hassan District, Karnataka, India. The site is in Kannada, with an English version.

- Address: Manakathuru, near Banavara, Arsikere Taluk, Hassan District, Karnataka
- Map: 13.436204, 76.170647 (https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&destination=13.436204%2C76.170647)
- Deity: Sri Kalabhairaveshwara, the fierce form of Shiva
- Festivals: Kalabhairavashtami (once a year), Karthika Deepotsava (lamp festival), Maha Shivaratri, and the annual jatre on the ninth day after Maha Shivaratri
- Getting there: buses run often from Arsikere and Kadur to Banavara, which is on the main highway; some trains stop at Banavara. Manakathuru is about 4 km north of Banavara.
- Also at the temple: a Hoysala-period Old Kannada stone inscription dated Śaka 1022 (1101 CE). It is kept in the temple courtyard but is not about this temple.
- Contact: kalabhairava.manakathuru@gmail.com
